messages:
alice: quick sync re: the docs panel UX — uploaded a compact prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-proto. two decisions needed: 1) terminology (we use 'Docs' vs 'Guides' in different spots) and 2) link behavior (open same tab vs new tab + indicators).

 tom: my take: top-level nav should read 'Docs' (broad). contextual items that point to how-to content can use 'guide' in the CTA. keeps nav short and CTAs descriptive.

 priya: +1. tiny accessibility concern: if link text and heading are identical, screen readers can get repetitive. recommend distinct aria-labels for actionable CTAs: e.g. aria-label="Open batching guide (opens in new tab)".

 alice: noted. on link behavior, QA flagged users losing console context when docs open in same tab. prefer open-in-new-tab for external docs, but we must mark them visually and programmatically.

 tom: agree open-in-new-tab. add a micro external icon next to link, and include an offscreen hint '(opens in new tab)'. devs: ensure rel="noopener noreferrer" + target="_blank".

 priya: accessibility checklist: visible focus ring for the link, aria-expanded on any panel toggles, role="dialog" if the panel behaves like a dialog, and announce when the panel content changes (aria-live="polite"). I'll run NVDA checks on the PR.

 alice: about anchors vs query params — docs team will add stable heading ids. my preference: use fragment anchors for direct jumps and add a ?src param for telemetry: /docs/console?src=panel#batching (confirm ordering: query then hash).

 tom: sounds good. telemetry event should be docs.link.click with props {source: 'panel', anchor: 'batching', label: 'batching'}. avoid full URLs or user identifiers in events.

 docs-bot: FYI: docs repo issue opened for stable summary frontmatter to support panel snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/512.

 alice: one more microcopy decision: current CTA is 'Learn more' which QA called ambiguous. options: 'Open docs', 'See batching guide', 'Read about batching'. pref for contextual 'See batching guide' when link maps to a specific guide; fallback to 'Open docs' otherwise.

 priya: +1. also add keyboard hint in footer: 'Press ? for shortcuts' — optional but useful. remember not to overload tiny panels with extra copy.

 tom: i'll add the external-link token (12px) to the design system and wire the docs-link component to the telemetry event. will add tests to ensure rel/target/aria-label are present.

 alice: great. i'll update the ticket with acceptance criteria: lexicon mapping (Docs vs Guide), link target behavior (new tab + rel), aria copy, telemetry schema, and panel a11y checks. pinging docs + eng for review after PR. thanks :raised_hands:
summary: Design thread resolving docs-panel terminology and link behavior: standardize top-level 'Docs' and contextual 'guide' CTAs, open docs in a new tab with external-icon and accessible hint, use fragment anchors + ?src param for telemetry, define telemetry event name and safe props, and list accessibility acceptance criteria (focus ring, aria-expanded, role, aria-live). Docs issue referenced for heading ids.
